implementation: Register Q named up front; read the brief's 'polish, not spectacle' as an explicit decline of the S register. ZERO dependencies. Fit gate before building the switch: no catalog/UI library installed; Radix/Headless UI would add a dependency tree for one control and still need re-theming; copy-in catalogs target expressive marketing effects, not quiet form controls -> custom on native input[role=switch], ~25 lines CSS. 2 files, 399 insertions. Motion: 150-200ms color/opacity, 160ms thumb slide, 1px active press. NO ambient animation anywhere - deliberately chose text 'Saving...' over a spinner partly so nothing needs pausing. Reduced motion verified under actual media emulation (transitions measured dropping 150-200ms -> 1e-05s). Keyboard verified only after switching to trusted CDP input when synthetic keys proved unreliable - explicitly refused to claim it until observed under a real input path (skill line 2). Found and fixed a real defect in verification: Save button wrapped to two lines at 375px.
